content:
After an unusually long three-week wait, new beta updates are now rolling out to developers, including iPadOS 27 beta 5. Here are the details.

iPadOS 27 and other Apple Beta 5 updates now available

The public release of iOS 27 is just over a month away, which typically signals that the beta release cycle is about to accelerate.

Apple today released beta 5 of iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, visionOS 27, and more.

For now, only developers can download and install the new updates. However, if Apple follows its usual pattern, public betas of the same software should be available within a day or two.

At this stage of the beta cycle, we don't expect to find any major user interface changes in Apple's software. Instead, August usually brings two main developments during Apple's beta phase:

  • The release frequency of new betas increases, typically once a week, but visible changes become less frequent
  • Apple's focus shifts to bug fixes and performance improvements

Apple has emphasized that iOS 27 and others will deliver performance gains over the previous generation.

While that's already the case to some extent during the beta phase, expect to see Apple's new software running more smoothly in beta 5 and over the coming weeks, along with more bugs being squashed.

That said, if there are actually any new features or noteworthy changes in today's update, we'll let you know.

Found anything new in iPadOS 27 beta 5 or other versions? Drop us a comment below.
